name: Grow Hackney
address: 98c Wallis Road, Main Yard, Hackney Wick
summary: A grassroots music venue, bar and kitchen by the River Lea in Hackney Wick, set in a former canalside factory and trading since 2014. Besides food and drink it hosts gigs, DJs, jazz, workshops and community events, and it runs on solar and green power.

music.notes: A mixed programme all year round that favours new artists, local crews and culture led by the community.

crowd: Under-18s can come until 8pm with a parent or guardian, and the Sunday afternoon canalside sessions are billed as the most family-friendly; most evening events are for over-18s.

accessibility.notes: The indoor bar area is the only wheelchair-accessible part, with a wheelchair-accessible side bar. Terrace, greenhouse and mezzanine are reached only by stairs. No BSL or captioning unless an event says so. Parking for access reasons can be requested by email.

cost.notes: Lots of events are free or cheap, but some are ticketed and late on Fridays and Saturdays there may be a charge on the door. Card and contactless only; cloakroom £2 an item.

age_policy: Under-18s with a parent or guardian until 8pm; most events 18+ (Challenge 25)

evidence.quote: Grow is an independent canalside cafe, bar, kitchen and grassroots music venue on the River Lea, serving Hackney Wick since 2014.
Repurposed from a canalside factory and built by artists, Grow is an independent bar, kitchen and grassroots music venue on the River Lea.
Grow runs on solar and green energy, pays the London Living Wage and supports local suppliers
Our programme moves through eclectic global sounds all year round, with a focus on emerging artists, local crews and community-led culture.
Grow hosts live music, DJs, jazz, workshops, talks, markets, community gatherings and cultural events in Hackney Wick.
We recommend canalside sessions on a Sunday (1pm-4pm) for our most family-friendly live music event.
Under-18s are welcome until 8pm if accompanied by a parent or guardian and seated at your table. Most evening events are 18+
Most events are 18+. Challenge 25 is in place
Many Grow events are free or low-cost, including live music, DJs, jazz and community events. Some events are ticketed
After 9pm on Fridays and Saturdays, guests may need to join the general queue and pay for entry, depending on the event.
Grow is a cashless venue. We accept card and contactless payments only.
The cloakroom is £2 per item at the main bar.
Venue address is: Grow Hackney, 98c Wallis Road, Main Yard, Hackney Wick, E9 5LN
The inside bar area is wheelchair accessible with an accessible gender-neutral toilet.
Grow has a wheelchair-accessible bar on the side with a height of 102 cm.
The outside terrace, greenhouse and mezzanine are not wheelchair accessible and can only be accessed via a series of stairs
This is the only wheelchair accessible area in GROW
There is no loop system for hearing aid users
We do not have BSL or live captioning at events, unless otherwise specified on the event page.
GROW can arrange parking for those who require it for access reasons. Please email hello@growhackney.co.uk to request this
Venue Capacity: Standing:290 // Dining:200 // Sq/ft:1000.00
